title: fix(app-shell, components): a record Edit or Delete greyed by disabledWhen says why

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg48yiCyRmnqoUoHcQ9VbBp6)_

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：对象写了 `userActions.edit.disabledWhen`（或 `delete.disabledWhen`）且条件成立时，记录页上灰掉的「编辑」「删除」现在会说明原因，用已有的通用句「对此记录不可用」（11 种语言已有翻译）。桌面端：悬停或键盘聚焦「编辑」出提示，读屏能读到；「···」菜单里的「删除」以及手机底栏「···」里的「编辑」显示第二行原因。
- **为什么改**：裁决 6996106574（「B 界面给通用原因」）。之前这种置灰没有任何说明，而状态锁和审批锁都有说明。
- **风险与回滚**：只改界面，不改协议、不加可写键、不加翻译键。审批锁、状态锁仍由各自的审批条和徽标说明，不会出现两条原因；按钮可用或记录还没加载完时不显示原因。回滚＝还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`（`editReason` 的先后判断：只在谓词是唯一原因时给通用句）；`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`（`disabledReasonFor` 对宿主动作只显示宿主自己带来的原因，从不给通用句）；`RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058.test.tsx` 新增的 describe。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058.test.tsx`，预期全绿，其中「a disabledWhen-greyed Edit or Delete says why」6 条通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `RecordDetailView` hands its header Edit a `disabledReason` (the existing `actions.notAvailableForRecord` sentence) only when `userActions.edit.disabledWhen` is what turned Edit off: not when the approval lock or the state lock also holds, since the approval band and the `record-state-lock` badge already explain those, so a reader never gets two reasons. The overflow Delete under `userActions.delete.disabledWhen` carries the same sentence (the ruling's rider; the predicate is the only thing that greys Delete there).
- `page:header`'s `disabledReasonFor` now draws a `disabledReason` that a host hands with one of its own header actions (`RecordContext.headerSystemActions`) when that action's declared `disabled` holds and the record is not pending. A host action that hands none stays silent, and only authored actions get the generic fallback, as before. The reason reaches every face through the existing paths: tooltip plus `aria-describedby` on the inline button (desktop), and a visible second line plus item description in the `⋯` (Delete, and a phone's off Edit, which #35133 moved into the bar's `⋯`).
- No `packages/spec/**` change, no new i18n key, no new exported prop or type (`disabledReason` is the existing `ActionSchema` key; the host's action defs are untyped `as any` as before).

## Tests

<details><summary>Local runs, head f599fad6</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` on the 39 ui test files that mention `disabledWhen` / `headerSystemActions` / `sys_edit` / `sys_delete`: `Test Files 39 passed (39)`, `Tests 736 passed (736)` (lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`), run at 19e21b03 plus the userActionPredicates fix; f599fad6 only adds one module-top import to `page-header-disabledReason-11811.test.tsx`, which was re-run alone at that content: `Tests 11 passed (11)`.
- New pins: `page-header-disabledReason-11811.test.tsx` (new describe: host Edit inline reason + tooltip; host Delete overflow reason; controls: pending record, action that is on) and `RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058.test.tsx` (new describe: desktop Edit, phone bar `⋯` Edit, desktop `⋯` Delete; controls: predicate not holding, state lock plus predicate gives only the badge, approval lock plus predicate gives only the band).
- Two existing pins read a menu entry by `textContent === 'Edit'` / `'Delete'`; they now read it by accessible name, since an entry with a reason carries a second line and its name stays the label (`expectEditInBarOverflowOff` in the phone harness; the Delete case in `RecordDetailView.userActionPredicates.test.tsx`).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: both `Done`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Ablation (one, on the tested behaviour), via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the host branch of `disabledReasonFor` replaced with `return undefined;` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `8bad2dd7` to `90c2811e`). Result: `Tests 5 failed | 32 passed (37)`; the five red are the five positive pins, every control stayed green. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- <path>`; blob back to `8bad2dd7` = HEAD blob; `git diff HEAD` empty. No dist step is needed: the ui vitest config aliases `@object-ui/components` to `src`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The host's reason goes through `localizeActionTexts` like any declared reason, so a bundle entry `objects.OBJECT._actions.sys_edit.disabledReason` would override it, the same way `_actions.sys_edit.label` already overrides the label. Not a new door, noted only.
- Out of scope, named by the dispatch: the list row buttons (`data-table.tsx`, the row kebab's built-in Edit / Delete under `disabledWhen`) grey with the same silence. Not changed here.
